items.quote: first you should find out just 2 things: Their MOTIVATION - Why they want to buy or sell, and why now? Their TIME FRAME - When they need this deal to happen and why this exact time?
items.statement: First you should find out just 2 things: Their MOTIVATION and Their TIME FRAME.

items.quote: - No presentations - No sending the client options - No viewing should be arranged unless you have 100% certainty
items.statement: No presentations, no sending options, no viewings should be arranged unless you have 100% certainty.

items.quote: you will find that you are working with serious clients and receiving way less objections.
items.statement: You will find that you are working with serious clients and receiving way less objections.

overview: A LinkedIn post offering a productivity tip for real estate agents engaging with new clients.
